question: Should OpenClaw retain `PluginRuntime.channel.turn` as a documented deprecated compatibility alias for previously shipped external channel plugins, rather than requiring all affected plugins to republish immediately?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally additive, but it changes the supported PluginRuntime contract and therefore needs an explicit owner decision about compatibility duration and deprecation policy.

options.title: Adopt the compatibility alias
options.body: Accept the additive alias, rebase the branch, and keep new plugin guidance on `channel.inbound.*`.

options.title: Require plugin republishing instead
options.body: Decline the host compatibility commitment and direct affected plugin owners to publish migrations to `channel.inbound.*`.

recommendation.title: Adopt the compatibility alias
recommendation.body: Accept the additive alias, rebase the branch, and keep new plugin guidance on `channel.inbound.*`.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the canonical compatibility report and can clarify the affected external-plugin contract, though code-history ownership remains unconfirmed.
